briefing: Stocks fell broadly today, with the NASDAQ down 1.6% and the S&P 500 down 1.5%, so the screener marked the day risk-off and returned no buy candidates. We are holding all 7 positions and the $545.88 in cash. Each holding keeps its automatic stop-loss and profit target, so no manual selling is needed.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A risk-off day is when investors get nervous and sell riskier assets like growth stocks, moving into safer places such as cash or bonds. On days like this, many stocks fall together no matter how good each company is. Holding back on new buys during risk-off periods helps you avoid buying into a market that is still falling.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者情緒轉趨謹慎，紛紛拋售成長股等高風險資產，轉而持有現金或債券等較穩健的資產。在這種日子裡，不論個別公司基本面如何，股價往往一同下跌。在避險氣氛濃厚時暫停建倉，可避免在跌勢未止時貿然入市。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell across the board today. The NASDAQ lost 1.6% and the S&P 500 lost 1.5%, a sign that investors were moving money out of riskier assets. No news headlines were provided in today's data, so we can't name a specific cause, but a broad drop like this usually reflects a change in overall market mood rather than one company's news.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日全面下跌，納斯達克指數下滑1.6%，標普500指數亦挫1.5%，反映投資者正從高風險資產撤出資金。由於今日數據未附帶新聞標題，暫時無法指出具體觸發因素；不過，如此廣泛的跌勢通常源於整體市場情緒轉變，而非個別公司消息。
